name: Tree diagrams
definition: When a choice is followed by another choice, a tree shows every path through them. Each level is one decision, each branch is one option, and every complete path from top to bottom is one outcome. Counting the ends of the branches counts the outcomes.
recognizeWhen: first you pick one and then you pick another
how many outfits from these shirts and trousers
each step has a few options
draw all the ways this can happen
misconceptions: I drew branches for the first choice but only one branch for the second.
I counted the lines in the tree instead of the endings.
I let the number of second choices vary when it should have been the same for every branch.
